# Genuine pre-ordered manifest-7 fixtures

Generated by unmodified writer/DSP/core source at `5b81430`, in an isolated detached checkout, using the additional console entry point retained as `LegacyPoolFixture.cpp.txt`. That entry point is QA setup only; it does not patch the baseline writer, loader, take hash, variation generator or graph. It saves and reloads each document through that baseline and asserts manifest 7. `provenance.json` records the exact producer/generator/fixture hashes.

Cases: stock effects on Track, Master and only in a variation; two source-pool choices with the alternate selected and choice-locked; routing, fades, track colour, layer/effect/parameter locks and individual effect bypass. Each contains a historical stock-only frozen take. Baseline static and take PCM are separate WAVs. `generation.soundplus` and `generation-expected.json` record the historical fixed-seed RNG result without changing canonical stock order. Take hashes and identities are committed as written, never regenerated by the current serializer.

Source references retain the baseline writer's absolute paths as part of historical take hashes. The regression validates the unmodified parsed state first, then refreshes/rebases live source file stamps for the test checkout and uses the explicit identical-content override path for frozen takes. No historical recipe hash is changed to make relocation pass.

To reproduce, add `LegacyPoolFixture` as a JUCE console target linking the baseline `soundplus_core`, build Release arm64, and invoke it with a fresh output directory. UUIDs/stamps naturally differ; PCM and fixed-seed behavior are deterministic. Do not run the generator over existing fixture files because JUCE output streams append to existing files.
